intent.raw: get what this is new type how it compares with arcanum/development/craft/ do we need to define another type?
intent.objective: Characterize the project-local 'operating-contract' artifact class (framework-gap #6), compare it against Craft and the other type registries, and decide whether to define another type — honoring the standing #6 deferral prior. Non-executed decision; arcanum changes proposal-only.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ordinary refinement requires ordered stage handoff, validation, owner boundaries, observability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each non-first stage consumes a prior frame and records a receipt; arcanum public-submodule owner boundary preserved (proposal-only).

technique_overlays.trigger: The core uncertainty is which of three type registries owns the artifact.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: An x-ray artifact maps the 3 registries and places or fails to place the artifact in each, with evidence.

technique_overlays.trigger: Several candidate homes (new artifact_type / reuse existing slot / defer) must be compared.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each candidate home scored on fit/cost/bloat; a pareto judgment selects with recorded rejected alternatives.

technique_overlays.trigger: Define-vs-reuse and real-gap-vs-premature-generalization are in tension.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The define/reuse positions are argued with a named convergence criterion; residue recorded.

technique_overlays.trigger: The #6 deferral prior is material and must not be silently overturned.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The prior (>=2-instance bar, candidate constitution, no validator) is carried into the decision and explicitly upheld or overturned-with-cause.

subagent_strategy.trigger: A fair interaction design needs independent perspectives: an interaction-designer, a skill-author, an ergonomics-critic (the naive-user/who-leads-when lens), each role-bound, joined by a synthesis architect.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The UX surface and the operating SKILL are different crafts; the ergonomics critique must be independent of the designer to be honest (the first principle is unproven). Role-bound sibling agents with isolated framing produce a fairer design than one voice; parent synthesis joins their receipts.
context: Ergonomics is the declared first principle and is still unmeasured (GAP-ERGONOMICS-UNPROVEN-001).
The runnable studio CLI (X2) already exists; the cold-start naive-user findings + ux-evidence report from the deep-spec are the evidence base.
Operator approved subagent spend across this project; review via domainspec-subagents-strategy is requested as the next step.

roles.purpose: Design the chosen interaction surface + the overlay mechanics + the human-agent loop.
Author the operating SKILL.md (the Claude-Code operating contract + discipline).
Attack each interaction decision on who-leads-when / cognitive load / friction (the naive-user + ux-evidence lens), independent of the designer.
Walk the interaction cold (only task goals + the rendered surface) to expose genuine friction.
Join the design + skill + critique + walkthrough into one coherent surface + plan.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the full UI/UX-interaction refine with 5 role-bound subagents (interaction-designer, skill-author, ergonomics-critic, naive-user, synthesis-architect)? Approve subagent execution under dispatch refine-ups-ui-ux-skill-20260616.
subagent_strategy.note: Lean tournament panel: advocates for candidate homes (new-type / reuse / defer); parent judges (pareto) + synthesizes. May run inline.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Baseline cites the SPEC interaction model, the CLI-native + annotation decisions, the ergonomics charter, and the cold-start/ux-evidence findings.

steps.name: Invoke Define — interaction surface + skill purpose (x-ray the flow)
Distill — tournament of interaction surfaces (overlay vs TUI vs local web)
convergence_criteria: Each surface scored on who-leads-when clarity, cognitive load, friction reduction, in-prototype annotation fidelity, and build cost.
Dominated surfaces eliminated with reasons; the non-dominated choice (or synthesis) named.
Rejected alternatives preserved in a residue ledger.
stop_conditions: One interaction surface selected with a pareto/ergonomics rationale.

steps.name: Invoke Design — interaction surface + author SKILL.md (autonomy vs control dialectic)
convergence_criteria: Produces the operating SKILL.md content (the Claude-Code operating contract + discipline).
Produces the interaction-interface design: overlay mechanics + the human-agent loop, with who-leads-when / cognitive-load / friction stated per step.
Each agent-autonomy-vs-human-control tension becomes a decision, a residue, or a deferred option.

steps.name: Distill Repair — dual walkthrough (naive user + Claude Code)
stop_conditions: A cold-start naive user and a Claude Code session each walk the interaction on a sample session; friction interpreted; repairs recorded.

steps.name: Invoke Plan — non-executed build plan for the overlay + skill install

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage names its native capability handle and expected receipt before execution.
External UX research runs only if a named gap appears and the operator confirms; default local-first; sources labelled external_context.
Surface tournament records advocates, pareto criteria, and rejected alternatives before a surface is selected.
Every kept/changed interaction decision states who-leads-when, cognitive load, and friction reduction (the ergonomics charter).
The dual walkthrough (naive user + Claude Code) is run with named friction + ux-evidence classes before planning.
Stage capabilities own their artifacts; no canonical SPEC/skill install without operator approval (the SKILL.md + design are proposals).
Subagent execution is approved before any subagent spawns.

promotion_guardrails: Refine does not install a live SKILL.md or mutate SPEC as canonical; it proposes — operator approval (and the requested domainspec-subagents-strategy review) precede any install.
Stage capabilities own their native artifacts; the manifest references them.
External UX research stays external_context until owner review.
